phrases.latin: Furnum accende, ut calefīat priusquam placentam indimus.
phrases.english: Turn the oven on, so that it heats up before we put the cake in.

phrases.latin: Ūnā edepol operā in furnum calidum conditō atque ibi torrētō mē prō pāne rubidō
phrases.english: While you’re at it, shove me into a hot oven and bake me there like a brown loaf

sources: Lewis & Short: furnus · Lewis & Short: calefacio · Lewis & Short: accendo
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 165.
